Indikator 10 measures 90-day mortality across Danish healthcare units, with a national development target of maintaining mortality below 18% [^src1]. For the 2023/24 measurement period, the national average for [[danmark|Danmark]] stands at 16.6%, successfully meeting the target [^src1]. At the regional level, four out of five regions meet the <18% threshold: [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] (16.1%), [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] (15.7%), [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] (16.0%), and [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] (17.8%) [^src1]. [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] is the only region to miss the target, recording a mortality rate of 19.6% [^src1].

Among individual hospitals, [[rigshospitalet|Rigshospitalet]] is a significant outlier, recording the highest mortality rate in the country at 30.2% [^src1]. While this is a marked improvement from its 50.0% rate in 2021/22, it remains far above the national average and fails the target [^src1]. Conversely, the best-performing hospital with reportable data is [[regionshospitalet-horsens|Regionshospitalet Horsens]] at 9.8% [^src1]. [[aalborg-universitetshospital-thisted|Aalborg Universitetshospital, Thisted]] reports 0.0%, but its data is suppressed with "#/#" indicating insufficient patient volume for a reliable calculation [^src1].

The "Opfyldt?" (Met?) column reveals a complex evaluation metric. While the stated target is <18%, several hospitals with point estimates well below this threshold are marked "Nej" (No). These include [[esbjerg-sygehus-grindsted-sygehus|Esbjerg Sygehus Grindsted Sygehus]] (12.0%), [[sygehus-lillebaelt|Sygehus Lillebælt]] (13.6%), [[hospitalsenhed-midt|Hospitalsenhed Midt]] (12.9%), [[regionshospitalet-goedstrup|Regionshospitalet Gødstrup]] (12.2%), [[aarhus-universitetshospital|Aarhus Universitetshospital]] (15.0%), [[aalborg-universitetshospital|Aalborg Universitetshospital]] (15.3%), and [[regionshospital-nordjylland|Regionshospital Nordjylland]] (12.2%) [^src1]. This discrepancy suggests that target fulfillment incorporates statistical confidence intervals or risk-adjustment mechanisms rather than relying solely on the raw point estimate.

Trends over the past three years highlight diverging trajectories among the hospitals. [[holbaek-sygehus|Holbæk Sygehus]] has shown steady and significant improvement, dropping from 27.7% in 2021/22 to 19.7% in 2022/23, and finally meeting the target at 16.8% in 2023/24 [^src1]. In contrast, [[sygehus-lillebaelt|Sygehus Lillebælt]] experienced a sharp decline in performance, worsening from a highly successful 4.9% in 2022/23 to 13.6% in 2023/24 [^src1]. [[aarhus-universitetshospital|Aarhus Universitetshospital]] also saw a notable increase in mortality, rising from 8.6% in 2022/23 to 15.0% in 2023/24 [^src1].

Summary: Tabellen sammenligner 90-dages mortalitet (Indikator 10) for alle 20 indberettende enheder og de fem regioner i Danmark for måleperioden 01.09.2023–31.08.2024, viser at kun tre regioner (Hovedstaden, Sjælland, Syddanmark) og ti hospitaler opfylder udviklingsmålet på < 18 %, mens flere hospitaler og Region Nordjylland overskrider grænsen.
